subject: Technical deep-dive: Redwood inference fit (post-discovery)
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Malik <samira@lumencloud.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Technical deep-dive: Redwood inference fit (post-discovery)

Hi Samira —

Thanks again for the discovery session earlier today. The product team gave us a good overview; looks like there are a couple of areas where a focused technical deep-dive would help accelerate an eval: networking/VPC topology, model sizing and memory footprint, and expected SLOs for tail latency under your traffic profile.

Recommended format: 60–90 minute live deep-dive (short demo + topology discussion + Q&A). Proposed slots (all PST):
- Tue Nov 16, 09:00–10:30
- Wed Nov 17, 14:00–15:30
- Thu Nov 18, 10:00–11:30

Can you confirm whether Nov 16 morning or Nov 17 afternoon are possible for your team? If neither, tell us your team’s availability the week of Nov 15 and we’ll align.

Prep questions so we come with focused material:
- Do you have a staging VPC we can review network egress rules for?
- Any enforced egress IP allowlists / corporate firewall constraints?
- Typical model sizes (approx. parameters) and peak concurrent requests we should target for the session.

I attached a short preflight checklist (basic items, non-sensitive) — please share anything you’re comfortable with ahead of the call. We can avoid any live load testing without explicit approval; if you prefer, we’ll run a lightweight replay on a small sample trace you provide.

Thanks — happy to adapt the agenda.

Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.ai
https://redwood.ai

Attachment: preflight_checklist.pdf (1 page)
From: Samira Malik <samira@lumencloud.io>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Cc: devops-team@lumencloud.io
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Technical deep-dive: Redwood inference fit (post-discovery)

Thanks, Jonas —

Appreciate the clear options. Quick notes from our side:
- The product team is mostly OOO early next week; the week of Nov 15 is better.
- Nov 16 09:00 PST should work for a 60-minute session (our preference is to keep it tighter).
- We have EMEA infra engineers who may join around 17:00 CET (so they would dial in remotely if timing allows).
- We can’t share production API keys; we can provide a sanitized trace and a short network egress matrix.
- No live load tests on our staging without a runbook + approval — fine with a lightweight replay if we agree on scope.

Please send an agenda and any links for calendar/Zoom. Recording is fine.

Samira Malik
Head of Platform | LumenCloud
samira@lumencloud.io

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Malik <samira@lumencloud.io>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 08:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Technical deep-dive: Redwood inference fit (post-discovery)

Hi Samira — thanks for the quick reply and the constraints.

Confirmed: we’ll plan for Nov 16, 09:00–10:00 PST (60 minutes). Proposed focused agenda (60 min):
1) 5 min — Introductions and success criteria
2) 15 min — Topology and network requirements (VPC, egress, ports)
3) 20 min — Model sizing and memory footprint recommendations + quantization/latency tradeoffs
4) 15 min — Integration considerations (prefix caching, batching, routing) + next steps

Preflight checklist / request (non-sensitive):
- Sample sanitized trace or request envelope (no API keys)
- High-level peak RPS and typical payload sizes
- List of outbound ports/IPs we should expect to reach (we attached a sample CSV)

We attached: preflight_checklist.pdf and network_ports.csv — these are just templates. We will not run any live load tests unless you explicitly sign off and provide a runbook. If you’d like, we can run a small traffic replay on a sanitized trace during the call at the end (5–10 minutes) to demonstrate tail behavior — only with prior approval.

Zoom (placeholder link): https://zoom.us/j/999888777
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/LC-2026-095

If that agenda looks good I’ll send a calendar invite.

—Ben
